full_judgment: Mr. Surendra Kumar Sinha, CJ.:- We have perused the impugned judgment and heard the learned Counsel of both the parties. The suit is a specific performance of contract. The trial Court rejected the plaint on the prayer of the defendant no. 3. It appears that the defendant no.1 had already executed a sale deed in favour of the petitioner who is added as defendant no.3 on the receipt of the consideration money. The High Court Division while maintaining the decree of the trial Court, directed the added defendant no.3 to return the earnest money TK.3,65,000/- to the defendant, although the added defendant no.3 is a bonafide purchaser of value without notice to the contract.
